sentences.en: They were deep in the red and closed up shop.
sentences.zh: 1. 他们入不敷出，只好关门大吉。

sentences.en: Most shops near the school are closed on Saturdays now.
sentences.zh: 2. 现在离学校近的大多数店铺星期六都关门了。

sentences.en: We were ignorant that the store was closed on Thursdays.
sentences.zh: 3. 我们不知道这家店星期四不开门。

senses.zh: 关；结束；接近（close的过去分词）
